parent_objective: design a hard/soft offtrack metric and termination split before any scenario redesign or measured rollout
blocked_by: M2436 promotes to task-boundary metric/termination redesign branch
counterfactual soft success must not become actual success
hard/soft offtrack semantics must be specified before implementation
supersedes: direct rollout under ambiguous offtrack semantics

public_gates: M2437 must specify hard offtrack, soft offtrack, collision-risk failure, and actual success semantics
M2437 must preserve that counterfactual relabeling is not actual success
M2437 must define admission criteria for a future implementation/validation milestone
M2437 must not run measured rollout, repair, train, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new measured rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines the hard/soft offtrack metric and termination contract required before implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new measured rollout, actual success claim, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats counterfactual soft success as actual success
stop if design omits hard offtrack failure semantics
stop if design routes directly to training instead of implementation/validation
stop if design claims scenario redesign was executed
fallback_plan: route to implementation if the contract is complete
route to metric lineage repair if required fields are missing
route to high-fidelity/backend preparation if current-sim semantics cannot be repaired
stop for user review if no bounded implementation route is supported

admission_evidence: M2436 synthesis promoted to task-boundary metric redesign branch
M2435 kept counterfactual soft success separate from actual success
allowed_updates: M2437 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: actual success remains an executed rollout outcome only
a bounded next route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2437 designs task metrics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2437; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2436 branch synthesis and M2435 threshold panel.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If metric semantics cannot be specified without actual-success leakage, stop for synthesis or user review before implementation.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: opens a new metric/termination redesign branch after synthesis
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can enable future implementation and measured validation; cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: design cannot choose implementation or stop
another design-only milestone is proposed without implementation
counterfactual soft success would leak into actual success

hypothesis: A hard/soft offtrack metric split design will make the next current-sim validation route well-defined without leaking counterfactual soft success into actual success.
success_criteria: hard offtrack, soft offtrack, collision-risk failure, and actual success semantics are specified
counterfactual soft success is explicitly barred from actual success
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected
no rollout repair training ranking actual-success or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2437 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2437 treats soft success as actual success
M2437 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2437 passes if it specifies a hard/soft offtrack metric split and selects a bounded implementation route without measured rollout, repair, training, ranking, actual-success, or verdict claims.
